icon.description:
Upon <death>Death $$death$</death> (nullified or not):
Drop <hl>$bomb_count$ small bombs</hl>, each exploding
after <hl>$bomb_duration$t</hl> and dealing <dmg>$min_dmg$-$max_dmg$ $$ddmg$</dmg>
to enemies within <hl>$aoe_radius$m</hl>.

<sk>$stack$$$sk$</sk> <hl>+$stack_bomb_count$</hl> bombs per stack.
